As an agent, GLL work in partnership with Hillingdon Council.
Queensmead Sports Centre
Queensmead Sports Centre on Victoria Road in South Ruislip offers a gym alongside a full-size sports hall that's home to badminton sessions and casual drop-in sports. The centre has outdoor floodlit tennis courts where you can book sessions or join club play, plus group exercise studios running classes daily. Badminton is particularly popular here, with regular court availability and support from First Choice Badminton Club. The sports hall also hosts birthday parties for kids looking to celebrate with active games. Opening times vary during the week as local schools use the facilities on weekday mornings and afternoons, but the centre runs a full schedule from 8am to 8pm at weekends when everything's available for community use.
Victoria Road
South Ruislip
London
HA4 0JE
